statement:
I'll look up the claim record first to see the claim amount.
The record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000 for this claim.

However, Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout limit of USD 50,000 according to its schedule. Since the approved amount of USD 480,000 exceeds the policy maximum, I can only pay up to the policy limit of USD 50,000.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "the approved amount of USD 480,000 exceeds the policy maximum" and gives the correct payable value of USD 50,000.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
